# Mola

> Mola is an app blocker and focus app for iPhone and iPad that needs no sign-up. It's free, with no ads, no tracking and no analytics.

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 18 or later) and iPad (iPadOS 18 or later); a focus timer on Apple Watch (watchOS 11 or later)
- Sign-up: none (no email, no password); the family feature pairs devices with a QR code and asks only for a display name
- Price: free
- Ads, tracking, analytics: none
- Where data lives: Your app selection, your plans, your focus history and your tile wall stay on your device; they are not sent to us.
- Languages: Turkish and English, along with German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and more.
- App Store: not released yet
- Publisher: mm-apps (https://mm-apps.com/), destek@mm-apps.com

## What it does

- You set the hours. The rest takes care of itself.: When a plan starts, the apps you chose close; when it ends, they open again. You can set up separate plans for weekdays, weekends or any days you like.
- You decide how much each day: Give the apps you choose a daily amount of time. When the time is up, those apps are blocked; your other apps stay open.
- Pomodoro, study or your own program: Choose one of the ready-made programs or set the focus time, the number of rounds and the break length yourself. You can also keep the apps you chose blocked while the session runs.
- A short pause before you give in: When you want to take a break during a balanced plan or end a session early, Mola asks you to wait a moment first. Sometimes that's enough. A strict plan can't be changed until it ends.
- Make your effort visible: Every tile gets its outline first, then its colors, and finally its glaze. You begin with the Seljuk star; as your wall grows, the Tulip, Carnation, Rumi, Çintemani, Hatayi, Interlace and Pomegranate patterns unlock, and you move from apprentice toward master.

## Questions

- Which devices does Mola work on? It works on iPhones running iOS 18 or later, iPads running iPadOS 18 or later, and Apple Watches running watchOS 11 or later.
- Do I need to create an account? No. There is no sign-up, email or password; you can start using Mola as soon as you open it. The family feature doesn't ask for an email address or phone number either: devices are paired with a QR code and you only write a name that your family will see.
- Can I use an app for only a set amount of time each day? Yes. Create a daily limit in the Today tab, choose the apps and set the daily time. When the time is up, those apps are blocked; if the limit's strictness level allows it, you can take a 5-minute break. To block them at certain hours instead, use a blocking plan.
- What if I really need an app I've closed? If your plan's strictness level allows it, you can take a 5-minute break. In balanced plans you wait 20 seconds before a break; in strict plans there are no breaks until the plan ends. You can turn off flexible and balanced plans in Mola at any time; a strict plan can't be turned off until its time is up.
- Can Mola see which apps I use? No. You choose apps with Apple's Screen Time picker; Mola doesn't even know the names of the ones you chose and stores only encrypted tokens that are valid on your device alone.
- What do I need to use the family feature? Just install Mola on both the parent's and the child's phone. We recommend setting up the child's Apple Account as a child account in Family Sharing; otherwise Screen Time access can be turned off in Settings on the child's phone.
- What happens to my data if I delete the app? Your plans, focus history and tile wall are stored on your device, so they're deleted along with the app. If you've used the family feature, the "Deleting your data" page explains how to delete your records on the server.
